open-country-wind.prompt: Open country under a light wind, dry grass moving, a sense of walking somewhere with nothing around. No trees close by. No music, no melody, no speech, no singing. Continuous even field recording that could loop.

spring-trickle.prompt: A small village spring running into a clay jug. A thin clear stream of water into a vessel, close and modest, not a fountain and not a waterfall. No music, no melody, no speech, no singing. Continuous even field recording that could loop.

village-yard.prompt: A farmyard heard from across it. A goat and a hen a good way off, some movement, nothing close enough to be in front. No music, no melody, no speech, no singing. Continuous even field recording that could loop.
